user.title: Add DomoSenso Photos
user.description: Choose where the photos come from. Each source gets its own entry.

albums.title: Set up photo albums
albums.description: Shared albums are copied into this folder as screen-sized JPEG files. Everything in it is readable without login when it lies under /config/www, so add only albums you are fine to show there. Add albums afterwards with Configure.

lightroom_folder.title: Lightroom photo folder
lightroom_folder.description: Photos from your Lightroom library are copied into this folder as screen-sized JPEG files, one folder per album and one per month for photos in no album. Everything under /config/www is readable without login. The first sync starts a minute after setup.

data_description.prefix: Leave empty to put the album folders straight into the photo folder, or name a subfolder, for example lightroom.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Adobe again
reauth_confirm.description: Adobe no longer accepts the Lightroom sign-in. Sign in again with the same Adobe account.

error.invalid_photo_dir: Enter the absolute path of an existing folder, for example /config/www/ramka.
error.invalid_prefix: Enter a folder inside the photo folder, without .. parts, or leave it empty.

abort.already_configured: Already set up: the Synology albums entry, or this Adobe account. Use Configure on that entry.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Adobe account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up with.
abort.account_unknown: Adobe did not say which account signed in. Try again.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. The Lightroom sync continues.
abort.missing_credentials: Add the Adobe application credentials (client ID and client secret) first.
abort.missing_configuration: Lightroom sign-in is not set up. Add the Adobe application credentials first.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The Adobe sign-in is not available right now. Try again later.
abort.oauth_error: Adobe returned an invalid sign-in token.
abort.oauth_failed: Getting the sign-in token from Adobe failed.
abort.oauth_timeout: Adobe did not answer in time while finishing the sign-in.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Adobe refused the sign-in. Check the client ID, the client secret and the redirect URI.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timeout while preparing the Adobe sign-in.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL to return to after the sign-in. See {docs_url}.
abort.already_in_progress: This is already being set up. Finish that setup first.

application_credentials.description: Create a project in the Adobe Developer Console ({console_url}) with the Lightroom Services API as an OAuth Web App, and register {redirect_url} as its redirect URI. Enter the project's client ID and client secret here. Use a project of its own for Home Assistant.

init.title: Photo albums
init.description: Add or remove a shared album, sync now or change the settings.

add_album.title: Add album
add_album.description: Paste a Synology Photos share link, with its password if it has one. The first sync runs now and can take a while for a large album.

data_description.path: Leave empty to use year/month/album name, for example 2026/11/Holiday.

remove_album.title: Remove album
remove_album.description: Deletes the photos this album synced and its sync marker. The folder is deleted only if nothing else is left in it; files you added by hand stay. The shared album itself is not changed.

sync_now.title: Sync now
sync_now.description: Leave the album empty to sync all albums. The sync runs in the background; the Albums sensor shows the result.

settings.title: Album settings
settings.description: Host map lines read `from -> to`, each an origin such as {example_origin}, to reach the share host by another address (for example on the local network). Redirects are not followed: map to the address that answers directly, for example the https address if http redirects there.

lightroom.title: Lightroom library
lightroom.description: Sync now, choose which photos are synced, or change the settings.

lightroom_sync_now.title: Sync now
lightroom_sync_now.description: The sync runs in the background; the Lightroom sensor shows the result. Confirm held changes applies the removals and moves a held sync kept back.

lightroom_settings.title: Lightroom settings
lightroom_settings.description: Changing the photo folder or the subfolder asks for a confirmation first.

lightroom_folder_confirm.title: Change the photo folder
lightroom_folder_confirm.description: Photos will be synced into {new}. Every photo is downloaded again, unless that folder already holds this library's photos. The photos in {old} stay where they are: the integration does not delete them. A running sync is stopped. Submit to change the folder.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A photo is synced when it meets every condition set here. An empty field sets no condition. Next shows what would change before anything is saved.

data.equipment_exclude: Camera or lens does not contain

data_description.albums_include: Empty: every album. A set includes every album below it.
data_description.albums_exclude: Wins over the albums above. A photo whose every album is excluded is not synced.
data_description.include_unfiled: Photos in no album go to one folder per month.
data_description.captured_last_years: 1 to 50; replaces the dates above when set.
data_description.equipment_include: Comma-separated; matches part of the make, model or lens, ignoring case.
data_description.equipment_exclude: Comma-separated; matches part of the make, model or lens, ignoring case.

filter_preview.title: Preview

filter_no_library.title: Preview
filter_no_library.description: No library has been read yet, so nothing can be counted. Save applies the filter, and the sync that follows reads the library.

filter_no_folder.title: Preview
filter_no_folder.description: The photo folder is missing (for example, its storage is not mounted), so nothing can be counted and the sync would not run. Save still applies the filter.

error.invalid_link: This is not a Synology Photos share link (https://host/mo/sharing/…) or it contains credentials.
error.wrong_password: The link password is wrong or missing.
error.unreachable: The share host cannot be reached. Check the link, the network or the host map.
error.invalid_host_map: Each line must read `from -> to`, where both sides are an origin only: http or https, host and optional port, without path, query, trailing slash or user name.
error.album_busy: This album is syncing right now. Try again when the sync has finished.
error.share_error: The first sync of this album failed. Check the link, the photo folder and the free disk space, then try again.
error.invalid_years: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50, or leave it empty.
error.invalid_range: This date is before the start date.
error.invalid_photo_dir: Enter the absolute path of an existing folder, for example /config/www/ramka.
error.invalid_prefix: Enter a folder inside the photo folder, without .. parts, or leave it empty.

abort.not_loaded: DomoSenso Photos is not loaded. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.no_albums: No albums have been added yet.

album_awaiting_confirmation.title: Album {name} waits for confirmation
album_awaiting_confirmation.description: More than half of the photos of album {name} ({path}) disappeared from the share, so no photo was deleted. If this is intended, call the action domosenso_photos.album_sync with this album and confirm_deletions, or use Sync now with Confirm held deletions.

album_path_collision.title: Album {name} was placed in another folder
album_path_collision.description: The wanted folder for album {name} already belongs to something else, so the album was placed in {path}. Rename or move the other folder, or set a folder for this album, if you want it elsewhere.

lightroom_awaiting_confirmation.title: {title} waits for confirmation
lightroom_awaiting_confirmation.description: The last sync of {title} removed and moved nothing because of a safety hold ({reason}): mass_remove means more than half of the synced photos would be removed, mass_unfile that more than half would move to month folders, empty_library that Adobe listed no photos. New photos were still added. If this is intended, use Configure, Sync now with Confirm held changes, or the action domosenso_photos.lightroom_sync with confirm.

lightroom_path_collision.title: {title}: folders got another name
lightroom_path_collision.description: The wanted folder name was already taken by another folder, so {count} folders got a number added. Their paths are in the path_collisions attribute of {entity}. Rename or move the other folder if you want the plain name; the next sync then renames these.

lightroom_ambiguous_folders.title: {title}: copied folders are left alone
lightroom_ambiguous_folders.description: More than one folder carries the sync marker of the same album, so none of these {count} folders is changed. Their paths are in the ambiguous_folders attribute of {entity}. Delete the copy, or the .sync.json file inside the copy, to let the sync continue.

lightroom_signin_expiring.title: {title}: Adobe sign-in ends soon
lightroom_signin_expiring.description: The Adobe sign-in of {title} ends on {expires}. It is normally renewed by the syncs; if it is not, Home Assistant asks you to sign in again once Adobe refuses it.

album_add.name: Add album
album_add.description: Adds a shared Synology Photos album without a password and runs its first sync. A link with a password returns the album with status auth_failed: add such links in the integration options (Configure -> Add album).

path.name: Folder
path.description: Folder inside the photo folder; empty uses year/month/album name.

album_remove.name: Remove album
album_remove.description: Removes an album: deletes the photos it synced and its sync marker, and the folder only if nothing else is left in it.

album_id.name: Album ID
album_id.description: ID from the albums attribute of sensor.domosenso_photos_albums.

album_sync.name: Sync albums
album_sync.description: Syncs one album or all albums now.

album_id.name: Album ID
album_id.description: ID of the album to sync; empty syncs all.

confirm_deletions.name: Confirm deletions
confirm_deletions.description: Delete photos that a held sync kept because more than half disappeared.

lightroom_sync.name: Sync Lightroom
lightroom_sync.description: Syncs one Lightroom library or all of them now and returns their state.

entry_id.name: Library
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the Lightroom library; empty syncs all.

confirm.name: Confirm held changes
confirm.description: Apply the removals and moves that a held sync kept back.

lightroom_preview.name: Preview Lightroom
lightroom_preview.description: Counts, from the cached library, what a sync with the current filter would keep, add, remove and move. Makes no request to Adobe.

entry_id.name: Library
entry_id.description: Config entry ID of the Lightroom library; empty previews all.

invalid_link.message: Not a Synology Photos share link.

unknown_library.message: No loaded Lightroom library has this entry ID.
